restaurants.name: Chipotle
restaurants.avoid: Burrito with rice, cheese, sour cream and guac; chips (540 kcal, 25 g fat).
restaurants.tip: Double chicken is the cheapest protein upgrade. Guac adds 22 g fat.

restaurants.name: CAVA
restaurants.avoid: Falafel, spicy lamb meatballs, glazed salmon, garlic dressing (20 g fat), whole pita.
restaurants.tip: Steak is the leanest main (170 kcal, 9 g fat). Curated bowls run 35 to 65 g fat.

restaurants.name: Panda Express
restaurants.avoid: Orange Chicken (560 kcal), Beijing Beef, Honey Walnut Shrimp, fried rice, chow mein.
restaurants.tip: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken is the only high-protein entree.

restaurants.name: Raising Cane's
restaurants.avoid: Caniac Combo (1,810 kcal, 106 g fat), Cane's sauce, fries (420 kcal).
restaurants.tip: Order fingers a la carte and use Louisiana hot sauce (0 kcal).

restaurants.name: Subway
restaurants.avoid: Tuna, Italian B.M.T. and 5 Meat Italian subs; any footlong (940 to 1,180 kcal).
restaurants.tip: Numbers are standard recipes with cheese and sauce. Skipping them lowers fat.

restaurants.name: Jason's Deli
restaurants.avoid: Chicken Club Salad original (1,110 kcal, 93 g fat), loaded potatoes.
restaurants.tip: Salads have a Lighter version; ask for it.

restaurants.name: 54th Street
restaurants.avoid: Buffalo Chicken Salad (1,500 kcal), fajita skillets, Caesar salad.
restaurants.tip: Ask for anything simply grilled. Grilled chicken breast add-on is 280 kcal, 52 g protein.

restaurants.name: Chili's
restaurants.avoid: Burgers (850 to 950 kcal), Quesadilla Explosion Salad (1,180 kcal), loaded street corn.
restaurants.tip: Fajita and sirloin numbers here are the protein alone or as served; tortillas extra.

restaurants.name: Freebirds
restaurants.avoid: Monster burritos, queso, Ancho dressing (about 260 kcal).
restaurants.tip: White meat chicken is about 97 kcal and 19 g protein per bowl portion.

restaurants.name: Chuy's
restaurants.avoid: Full fajita plates (about 1,600 kcal, 92 g fat), Chuychanga, chips and queso.
restaurants.tip: No official nutrition. Treat every number as a ballpark.

restaurants.name: Wings Over
restaurants.avoid: Breaded boneless wings, bone-in wings by the dozen, ranch.
restaurants.tip: Bone-in wings run about 90 to 100 kcal each per Wings Over. Grilled tenders are the pick.

restaurants.name: Mariana's Tacos
restaurants.avoid: California burrito, carne asada fries, Chips Supreme, chimichanga, taco salad.
restaurants.tip: Ask whether pollo asado is breast or thigh. Corn tortillas over flour.

restaurants.name: Chick-fil-A
restaurants.avoid: Waffle fries (420 kcal medium), creamy dressings (280 to 310 kcal), Chick-fil-A sauce.
restaurants.tip: Cool Wrap with dressing on the side is the best base. Add grilled nuggets for more protein.

restaurants.name: McDonald's
restaurants.avoid: Big Breakfast with Hotcakes (1,340 kcal), Double QPC (42 g fat), large fries.
restaurants.tip: No high-protein, low-fat item. Pick another place if you can.

restaurants.name: Whataburger
restaurants.avoid: Triple Meat Whataburger (1,070 kcal), biscuits, pancake platters.
restaurants.tip: Grilled chicken salads and the Grilled Chicken Melt are the best ratios.

restaurants.name: Taco Bell
restaurants.avoid: Grilled Cheese Burritos (680 to 690 kcal), Cheesy Gordita Crunch, Cantina Chicken Bowl.
restaurants.tip: Chicken Soft Tacos are 160 kcal and 12 g protein each.

restaurants.name: Wendy's
restaurants.avoid: Baconator (890 kcal, 58 g fat), Dave's Double and Triple, cheese fries.
restaurants.tip: Parmesan Caesar Salad is 31 g protein before dressing.

restaurants.name: Sonic
restaurants.avoid: SuperSonic burgers, Ultimate breakfast burrito (56 g fat), tots and fries.
restaurants.tip: No grilled chicken on the menu. Tenders are the best option.

restaurants.name: Jack in the Box
restaurants.avoid: Grande Sausage Burrito (1,040 kcal, 69 g fat), Bacon Double Smashed Jack.
restaurants.tip: Salad numbers exclude dressing.

restaurants.name: Burger King
restaurants.avoid: Bacon King (1,260 kcal, 84 g fat), Triple Whopper, Original Chicken Sandwich.
restaurants.tip: Flame-Grilled Chicken Sandwich is the only good ratio.

restaurants.name: First Watch
restaurants.avoid: Power Breakfast Bowl (860 kcal, 63 g fat, 33 g protein), omelets (1,120 to 1,140 kcal, about 80 g fat), Barbacoa Chilaquiles Bowl, Million Dollar Bacon and Potatoes.
restaurants.tip: Power Wrap is the only low-fat entree (11 g). Ham is the leanest protein side.

restaurants.name: Shake Shack
restaurants.avoid: Fries (470 kcal, 22 g fat), cheese and bacon fries, SmokeShack and Avocado Bacon doubles (50+ g fat), honey mustard and ranch.
restaurants.tip: Lettuce wraps cut carbs, not fat. A plain Single Hamburger plus an extra patty is the best protein for the fat.

restaurants.name: Hopdoddy
restaurants.avoid: Wagyu and Doddy Melt burgers (60 to 87 g fat), Caesar Smash, any fries (regular 26 g fat), truffle anything, Doddy Mayo.
restaurants.tip: Ask for the chicken patty (180 kcal, 31 g protein, 5 g fat) on an egg bun with a light sauce. Add a second patty for more protein.

restaurants.name: Jersey Mike's
restaurants.avoid: #8 Club and Turkey Club (75 to 78 g fat regular), Chipotle subs, #13 Original Italian, any Giant, chips (16 g fat).
restaurants.tip: #19 BBQ Beef is the leanest high-protein sub (60 g protein, 11.5 g fat). Order any sub as a Sub in a Tub to drop about 300 kcal of bread.

restaurants.name: Firehouse Subs
restaurants.avoid: Pepperoni Pizza Meatball (88 g fat medium), Chicken n' Cheddar Rancher, Turkey Bacon Ranch, Brisket, any Large, ranch or oil and vinegar (28 to 34 g fat).
restaurants.tip: Firehouse Salad with chicken is 41 g protein for 350 kcal. Get Light Italian on the side.

restaurants.name: Smoothie King
restaurants.avoid: Keto Champ (33 g fat), The Hulk (690 to 820 kcal), Peanut Power Plus, Daily Warrior, Protein Boxes (27 to 31 g fat), 32 and 44 oz sizes.
restaurants.tip: Gladiator is 45 g protein for 220 kcal. Pick Activator Recovery after training when you want carbs. Enhancers are not counted.
